lines.text: Many learners say: We have a reunion at three o'clock.
Better: We have a meeting at three o'clock.
A work meeting is a meeting.

data.wrong: We have a reunion at three o'clock.
data.right: We have a meeting at three o'clock.
data.why: A work meeting is a meeting.

quiz.stem: I have a ___ with my boss at three.

native.tip: En anglais, “reunion” veut dire « retrouvailles ». Pour une réunion de travail, dites “meeting”.

en.tip: In English, “reunion” means getting together again. For a work meeting, say “meeting”.
en.caption: Do you say this? “We have a reunion at three o'clock.” In English, “reunion” means getting together again. For a work meeting, say “meeting”. Say “We have a meeting at three o'clock.” Listen to Carlos and repeat with him! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
